subject.title: Telegram: support fail-closed unknown-group handling with optional auto-leave

question: Should OpenClaw accept an opt-in Telegram unknown-group action config that can warn and leave non-allowlisted groups, using the open paired PR as the starting point?
rationale: The change adds user-facing config and an authorization side effect in a channel security boundary, so automation should not choose the permanent behavior or merge shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Revise the paired Telegram PR
options.body: Use the existing implementation candidate, but require precise unknown-group classification, schema/docs alignment, and real Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Keep current deny-only behavior
options.body: Decline the warn/leave config for now and keep current fail-closed drop/log behavior as the supported Telegram posture.

options.title: Fold into broader group security work
options.body: Defer this narrow auto-leave request into the broader group pairing or cross-channel group security direction.

recommendation.title: Revise the paired Telegram PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing implementation candidate, but require precise unknown-group classification, schema/docs alignment, and real Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Telegram authorization and config surfaces most directly trace through this person's recent area work, and the choice affects that boundary.
